items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: The conductor was Charlie Drury, he used to conduct the show and he used to have a light that he would stand in the middle and he would conduct both bands. Sometimes both bands would be playing at the same time in the show.

ctx.x: A beautiful show. Two bands, Ben Pollack's band and Don Redmon. And we used to play the show together. The conductor was Charlie Drury, he used to conduct the show and he used to have a light that he would stand in the middle and he would conduct both bands. Sometimes both bands would be playing at the same time in the show.
